task: Cross-platform zero-shot 3D visual grounding, one sensor frame per prediction
source_state: Existing epoch100 and matching R91 full_disc state belonging to the same source
sampling: 16384 points using NumPy default_rng; replace only if the cloud is smaller. Seed 0 by default; historical comparisons retain their sealed input seeds.
default: Complete frozen A readout, R158 overlap decision on A256, R155 sampled-A PCA, return box in raw target LiDAR frame
primary_table: All 5942 ordinary R158 extra single-frame direction-records, same geometry and seeds per record, per-direction ordinary means and equal weight over six directions
secondary_tables: 1798 development records forcing A for all. On the 764 registered records only, compare A with A+B within the same records using original design weights. Mixed availability is historical context only.
accept_runtime: From raw sensor files with camera-only metadata and uncached text parsing, reproduce both sealed winners, final boxes and all 256 prepared-source probabilities. Use first record in each direction, include each available Waymo camera view for both sources. Check inverse coordinates and a novel expression.
holdout: Ordinary, previously exposed validation data only; no FINAL access or target tuning
